faq.q2: Is there an online payment option?

about.heroSubtitle: Content App is a quiet corner of the internet — no ads, no tracking, no algorithmic noise. Just carefully chosen stories in English and Bengali, built to be read, understood, and remembered.
about.whyStartedP1: The web has become loud. Every article is wrapped in autoplay videos, pop-ups, cookie banners, and three different ad networks. We got tired of it — so we built something else.
about.whyStartedP2Before: Content App started as a small experiment in
about.whyStartedP2After: what if reading could feel calm again? What if stories respected your attention, and what if bilingual readers didn't have to choose between languages?
about.whyStartedP3After: a small team based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We're not a startup chasing scale — we're readers who wanted a better reading experience and decided to make one.
about.whyStartedP4: This isn't a product. It's a project. It exists because people show up to read, give feedback, and occasionally help cover hosting costs. If you find something useful here, that means we did our job.
about.careAboutSubtitle: Four principles guide every decision we make.

values.readingDesc: Clean typography, distraction-free layouts, and reading progress that actually helps.
values.bilingualDesc: Every story is written and available in English and Bengali — not auto-translated.
values.listenDesc: Built-in text-to-speech lets you listen while commuting, cooking, or resting your eyes.
values.trackingDesc: No analytics pixels, no ad networks, no third-party trackers following you around.

about.insideSubtitle: Small details that add up to a calmer reading experience.

features.twoLangDesc: English and Bengali side-by-side. Switch anytime with one click.
features.ttsDesc: Natural voice reading in both languages — perfect for multi-tasking.
features.originalDesc: Stories written by humans, edited by humans, for humans.
features.fastDesc: Built with Next.js and optimized for slow networks.
features.communityDesc: Suggestions, corrections, and requests come from readers like you.
features.focusedDesc: One job, done well: helping you read and finish what you start.

timeline.ideaDesc: Frustrated by ad-heavy reading platforms, we sketched a simple, honest reading app.
timeline.protoDesc: A bilingual reading experience with TTS was built and tested with a small circle.
timeline.launchDesc: Content App went live — free for everyone, no sign-up wall on public stories.
timeline.growDesc: Adding more stories, better accessibility, and a mobile app in the pipeline.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.subtitle: Guidelines for a respectful community
rules.intro: Four principles that keep Content App a calm, honest place to read.

rules.kindDesc: Assume good faith. Disagree with ideas, never attack people. Slurs and personal attacks are not allowed.
rules.valueDesc: Comments should add something — a question, a counterpoint, a useful link. Spam will be removed.
rules.honestDesc: Don't plagiarize. Credit sources. If you use AI to help write, review and edit before publishing.
rules.respectDesc: Don't share others' personal information without permission. Screenshots of private messages are not allowed.

rules.ctaSubtitle: A calm reading community starts with each of us.
